listing.name: Upgraded Rotary Weapons
listing.summary: Replaces vanilla rotary weapons' animations with smoother, progressively spinning ones and updates the Storm Needler's sound and muzzle flash.

aiDescription: This utility mod improves the visual feedback of rotary weapons by replacing their animations with smoother spin-up and spin-down effects. It also increases rotation speed when using the Accelerated Ammo Feeder. Additionally, the vanilla Storm Needler's sound and muzzle flash are replaced, with an alternative version available to retain the original audio.
